Ward Scribe

Your marks appeared over doors, cradles and caravan wheels. Sometimes they held.

Which mark will you never draw carelessly?

Rules

Choose one:

- Guard 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.65bc5b597540c33a.JournalEntryPage.486b7a184a71013a]{A Sign against Harm}. - Armor 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.68753f5663bfea67.JournalEntryPage.fa5e21fa615d88a0]{Wake the Iron Rune}.

Type: Background

Each option is a pair. Duplicate grants give 1 level-0 DP each; no automatic higher rank. Follow the card’s equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +10 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
